evals.name: obvious-small-change
evals.prompt: 先规划，不要实现：把这个项目 web/index.html 的页面标题和 h1 从 Credit admin 改成 Credit console。没有其他改动。
evals.expected_output: For an obvious small change, explain and stop without creating a plan or implementing.
expectations: For the obvious one-file edit, explains that planning is unnecessary and stops without creating a plan or mini-plan.
Does not implement, alter project source, or create commits.
Does not invent test, experiment, or implementation success.

evals.name: api-web-retry-plan
evals.prompt: 请为这个项目规划一次跨后端和管理页的重试安全改造，先只写计划。我已决定：POST /issue 增加必填 requestId，同一 ID 和相同 credits 重试时返回原结果且只发放一次；相同 ID 但不同 credits 返回 409；不同 ID 正常分别发放。页面同一次操作失败重试要复用 ID，刷新后余额仍正确；新增真正独立发放时生成新 ID。进程内存储即可，不加数据库。API 和页面都在范围内，必要的测试和性能探针也可调整。已有接口 p95 预算是 50 ms，页面提交到余额显示的预算是 500 ms。请基于当前代码拆成可交付的 PR，并说明怎么验收。设计方向已经确定，无需原型。不要实现、提交、发布或合并。
evals.expected_output: A repository-grounded ready Markdown plan with dependencies, both surfaces, truthful trunk comparison, concrete commands, numeric perf budgets, interaction review and a checked handoff.
expectations: Produces a repository-grounded PR plan with explicit dependency and branch/file boundaries, rather than generic task bullets.
Preserves request-ID semantics: same-ID same-payload returns the original result once, conflicting payload returns 409, and new issuance uses a new ID.
Plans real API and Web verification including trunk/head comparison, retry, and refreshed user-visible state.
Defines reproducible boot and check/probe commands, evidence destinations, and version/invalidation boundaries without inventing measured results.
Plans performance measurement with the stated 50 ms API and 500 ms visible-state limits, including baseline and comparable probe procedure.
Requires operator interaction review of screenshots and video before merge, with explicit execution and merge authorization boundaries.
Does not implement, alter project source, or create commits.
Passes feasibility with matching actual observations or returns Draft for load-bearing unknowns; a product direction alone is not evidence.
Maps acceptance to PR observations and evidence, plans check sensitivity, and requires operator review of weakened criteria.
Requires a real PR with /opening-a-pr and non-author /verify-pr verification before merge-ready, without performing unauthorized publication.

evals.name: unsettled-delivery-spike
evals.prompt: 先帮我规划给这个管理页加实时余额更新。我还没决定用 SSE 还是轮询，部署网关对长连接和断线重连的实际行为也没验证，我不想直接拍脑袋选。请先查看项目，指出怎样把方案定下来；暂时不要跑实验，也不要改代码。
evals.expected_output: Identify the design blocker and return a concrete Spike task, not a ready implementation plan or an invented experiment result.
expectations: Recognizes SSE versus polling and gateway/reconnection behavior as unresolved design blockers instead of choosing an unsupported implementation.
Returns a concrete Spike task with alternatives, required observations/evidence, and a decision/handoff criterion.
Does not present a ready implementation plan or claim an unrun experiment proved the design.
Respects the no-experiment instruction and does not implement, alter project source, or create commits.

evals.name: parallel-shared-resources
evals.prompt: 只写计划：两个团队分别改 API 和网页，文件不同，想同时开发并验收。它们目前都启动到同一 3000 端口，都用会在启动时清空的 credit_test 数据库。接口 requestId 将从可选变成必填，网页仍按旧合同请求。请拆 PR，说明哪些能并行，哪里先处理。不允许改代码、跑实验或启动子 agent。
evals.expected_output: A Draft or grounded plan that separates interface/caller migration, exclusive writes, process/database isolation and post-wave integration. Different files alone do not justify parallelism.
expectations: Identifies port, database, reset and contract conflicts beyond file overlaps.
Preserves compatible intermediate PR states; shared interface has one owner or prerequisite.
Specifies parallel groups with branches, writes, resources, contract and integration checks.
Does not implement, start experiments or delegate.

evals.name: metric-proxy-and-weakening
evals.prompt: 只做计划审阅，不运行项目：一份重试改造计划已写 Ready。验收是页面提交到余额显示 <=500ms；浏览器未安装，于是作者改用 curl <=500ms。丢包测试在请求发出前 abort，作者称证明了入账后响应丢失时重试安全。原先预算已获批准，现在作者说接口够快就可把 UI 预算删掉。请给可执行的修正交接，不要实现。
evals.expected_output: Reject readiness and preserve approved criteria. Name browser observation and post-side-effect response loss, runnable driver/proxy ownership and recipe, and operator review of criterion changes.
expectations: Does not treat HTTP time as page-visible latency proof.
Does not treat pre-execution cancellation as a committed operation with a lost response.
Requires actual driver/proxy creation, launch/ports/readiness/teardown and evidence.
Blocks Ready until proof exists; weakening acceptance requires separate operator review.
